title: Prohibitions of Ehraam
introduction:
PROHIBITIONS OF EHRAAM

These actions are prohibited after wearing Ehraam:

1. Hunting wild animals.

2. Sexual relations with women, kissing, looking lustfully or obtaining any kind of pleasure.

3. To perform marriage of a woman for oneself or for others.

4. Masturbating

5. Applying scent

6. Wearing stitched clothes.

7. Applying antimony for make up.

8. Looking at a mirror.

9. Wearing such a shoe that the whole upper part of feet gets covered.

10. Telling lies, abusing or being arrogant.

11. Swearing by the name of Allah.

12. Killing an lice etc. living on one's body.

13. Wearing a ring as ornament.

14. Wearing ornaments (for women).

15. Massaging the body with oil.

16. Cutting one's or others' hair be he wearing an Ehraam or not.

17. Covering whole head with anything (for men).

18. Covering whole face with anything (for women).

19. Walking in shade (for men).

20. Taking out blood from one's body.

21. Cutting nails.

22. Extracting a tooth.

23. Uprooting tree or grass in the sanctuary.

24. Carrying a weapon.
